blurb: Two monster overs (112.8 with 52 and 24; 83.7 with 9 blocks last night) and two unders, all on minutes held to 24-26 in blowouts except the 34 in a close game. Efficient shooting and blocks drive it. Expect a wide range above his high-50s number, with blowouts the main risk to his minutes.

name: Alijah Martin
blurb: Minutes well above his usual (16, 31, 21, 16 against 10): a 38.3 on 6-7 from three, a 12.1 when ETR priced him up, then an in-line 18.2. Expect a mid-teens number while the minutes last.

name: Allen Graves
blurb: A small role growing a little: minutes 9-20 against a usual 13, two overs and two in line, the latest 19.0 on 3-4 from three. Expect a low number with occasional pops.

name: Collin Murray-Boyles
blurb: Two overs on extra minutes (28 and 34, with 4 steals in the second), two in line, then 15.3 in 20 minutes. Minutes swing 20-34 around a usual 22. Expect in line around his low-to-mid-20s number, over when the minutes stretch.

name: Immanuel Quickley
blurb: Never over: four in line and one under, the under 22.8 on 28 minutes in his return from the hamstring. Minutes had been well above his usual before that (32-38). Expect in line to a little under his low-30s number while his minutes are managed.

name: Jakob Poeltl
blurb: A bigger role: minutes went 23, 19, 31, 31 and 32 against a usual 23, with overs of 43.7 and 42.6, then 18.3 on 6 points despite 32 minutes. The minutes are sticky; expect at or above his low-to-mid-20s number while they hold.

name: Ja'Kobe Walter
blurb: Never over: three in line and two unders with no stocks. Last time was 27.1 on 5-10 from three in 35 minutes. Minutes sit around 32; expect in line around his mid-20s number.

name: Jamal Shead
blurb: Two big overs (42.6 and 41.9 on 34-36 minutes with Barnes and Quickley out), then 16.6 on 22 minutes with Quickley back. His minutes track Toronto's absences: expect in line to under his number with Quickley playing, well over it when he sits.

name: Jamison Battle
blurb: Mixed: 1 over, 3 in line and 1 under. Minutes went 20, 19, 17, 21, then 19 against a usual 16, so the role is bigger than his average says. Rebounding below his rate in 2 of 5.

name: RJ Barrett
blurb: Steady: three in line, one over on 37 minutes, one under (7-21). Last time was 39.1 despite 5-16 shooting, on 31 minutes. Expect in line with his mid-30s number.

name: Scottie Barnes
blurb: Three overs in five, then a -12 last night on 5 turnovers in a loss. Minutes steady around 35; ETR prices him above his usual, so his number is fair.

name: Ace Bailey
blurb: Never over, but improving: three unders, then two in line, including 32.4 last night on 35 minutes. The bad nights were cold shooting (2-11, 3-9) and a blowout. Minutes are solid around 31; expect in line around his low-30s number.

name: Darryn Peterson
blurb: Three overs in five, scoring above his rate, on steady minutes (30-35, usual 31). Last night was in line at 33.8 with 25 points on 10-19, against ETR's 36.7. The role is sticky; expect in line or better with his mid-30s number.

name: Isaiah Collier
blurb: A backup whose role comes and goes: minutes swung 3-24, and the 24 last night produced 31.5 (in line against ETR's 26.6). ETR priced him above his usual for that game (27 vs 17). If the minutes hold, a real number; if not, a low one.

name: Jaxson Hayes
blurb: In line in three of five, an over on 37 minutes and an under on 4 turnovers. Minutes swing 20-37 around a usual 24. Expect his number.

name: Josh Okogie
blurb: Never under, on more minutes than his average (19-28 lately, usual 14), with two overs. It's a small role, but it's growing; expect him at or over his number.

name: Keyonte George
blurb: Swinging: cold 2-10 and 3-12 nights (the second 22 minutes in a blowout), then a 66.9 on 44 minutes and a 41.0 with Lauri out. Minutes swing 22-44 around a usual 32. His overs came on extra minutes when Utah was short; expect volatile around his mid-30s number.

name: Kyle Filipowski
blurb: A fringe big: 8-9 minutes early, then 15 minutes and a +15 over with Markkanen out. ETR has had him well below his usual. Only worth a look when Utah's frontcourt is short.

name: Lauri Markkanen
blurb: Never under: over twice (31 minutes, then 39) and in line on 8-15 from three last time. Minutes 29-39 against a usual 30. He's at or above his number.

name: AJ Dybantsa
blurb: Never over: three in line and two unders, both on cold shooting (4-12; 6-15 with 0-4 from three). Minutes are steady around 34. Expect in line to a little under his low-30s number.

name: Alex Sarr
blurb: Two overs with AD out, then two unders with AD back (18.6 and 12.6, the latter 2-6 with no stocks). His role shrinks with Davis on the floor; expect under his mid-20s number while AD plays.

name: Anthony Davis
blurb: Never under: two overs (51.5; 61.1 on 16-21) and three in line, the latest exactly ETR's 44.6. Minutes are steady at 30-34 and efficient shooting drove the overs. Expect at or above his mid-40s number while healthy.

name: Bilal Coulibaly
blurb: In line in three of five, with an over on 8-9 and an under through 5 fouls. ETR has had him below his usual. Minutes 22-33. Expect his number.

name: Bub Carrington
blurb: Mixed and slipping: three in line, one over on stocks, then 0.0 in 10 minutes. Minutes swing 10-21 around a usual 19, and ETR priced him below his usual last time. Expect a low number.

name: Deandre Ayton
blurb: Swings with his minutes: an over on 23 minutes and 11 rebounds, unders on 24 minutes with 4 points and 7 minutes in a blowout. Minutes 7-24. No trend; expect his number with a low floor.

name: Kyshawn George
blurb: Mixed: two overs (55.3 with AD out; 39.4), two in line, one under (5-12 with AD back). Minutes are up (36 a game against 34), and last time was an in-line 34.3 on 39 minutes. Expect in line with his low-30s number with AD playing.

name: Trae Young
blurb: Never over: three in line and two unders, the latest 27.6 with only 4 assists. Assists have run below his rate in four of five against tough defenses. Minutes sit around 34; expect a little under his high-30s number.

name: Tre Johnson
blurb: A bigger role: minutes 27-29 in his last four against a usual 20. Two overs (25.7 on 5-10 from three; 28.1 with 3 steals) and two cold in-line nights (2-15, 1-8). The minutes are sticky and the shot is the swing; expect him over a low-teens number more often than not.

name: Will Riley
blurb: A fringe role: 1, 5 and 20 minutes in his three games, in line each time against ETR's low numbers. Expect little unless the minutes stick.
